events.text: Success brings stalkers, think-pieces, and 4,000 quote-tweets about your haircut.

effects.tpl: Assistants, boundaries, beach. Peace restored.

events.title: Feast invitation!
events.text: A wealthy cousin invites House {{s.lastName}} to a grand feast: roast, wine, gossip.

effects.tpl: You toast, dance, network. +10 prestige!
Your gift steals the night. Bards mention House {{s.lastName}}. +22 prestige!
You stay home. The pies were apparently legendary.

events.title: Family feud!
events.text: A rival branch of the family insults House {{s.lastName}} at a gathering. Everyone watches.

then.tpl: Your toast is so sharp it cuts. The hall erupts. +18 prestige!

else.tpl: Your comeback lands flat. Whispers follow you.

effects.tpl: Grace disarms them. The elders nod. House honor grows.

events.title: Flat at midnight
events.text: Midnight, rain, nowhere: a tire strands {{s.firstName}} as trucks spray past.

then.tpl: Twelve wet minutes. Soaked, triumphant.

else.tpl: The jack wins round one. You win round two, shivering.

effects.tpl: Warm car, warm wait, warm bill.

events.title: The sushi
events.text: The gas-station sushi seemed fine at the time to {{s.firstName}}. It was not fine.

effects.tpl: Diagnosed: never again. You frame the discharge papers.

then.tpl: Twenty-four brutal hours. You survive on crackers.

else.tpl: Dehydrated and humbled. The ER anyway: minus $700.

events.title: Grandchild!
events.text: Your child calls, voice shaking with joy: you're going to be a grandparent!

effects.tpl: Tiny hands, huge love. Grandparent mode: activated.
Books, calls, birthday magic from afar.

events.title: Sharp pain!
events.text: Something pops during a heavy lift.

effects.tpl: Strain, not tear. $600 and six boring weeks.

then.tpl: It fades. You feel invincible (wrongly).

else.tpl: Torn ligament. Months of regret.

events.title: Gym era
events.text: Everyone's getting fit. The gym offers a teen deal.

effects.tpl: Six months of iron. Transformation arc complete.
Push-ups in the bedroom. Slow but real gains.

events.title: Hackathon weekend
events.text: 48-hour hackathon. Free pizza, no sleep, big prizes.

then.tpl: Your app wins 2nd place! $1,500!

else.tpl: No prize, but you learn more in 48h than a semester.

effects.tpl: You sleep 10 hours while friends hallucinate code.

events.title: Weird lump
events.text: You find something odd. Dr. Google says everything from 'nothing' to doom.

then.tpl: Benign! $500 for the best sleep of your life.

else.tpl: Early-stage issue caught early. Treatment works. Scary year.

then.tpl: It vanishes. You feel smug and lucky.

else.tpl: It was serious. Ignoring it cost your health dearly.

events.title: Kitchen fire!
events.text: Grease fire! Flames lick the cabinets.

effects.tpl: Fast action saves the house. $2,500 damage.
Water spreads grease fire! $12,000 damage. Never again.

events.title: Boar hunt!
events.text: Friends (or vassals, you joke) plan a weekend boar hunt. Mud, dogs, glory.

then.tpl: A clean chase! The boar feeds the village. +14 prestige!

else.tpl: The boar disagrees. Muddy, bruised, humbled.

effects.tpl: You guard the pies. Someone must.

events.title: Letter from a lawyer
events.text: A distant relative left you something in their will.

then.tpl: A check for ${{w}}! You cry a little.
A box of letters and a pocket watch. Priceless, not spendable.

else.tpl: JACKPOT: ${{w}}! A paid-off house sold for you.

events.title: Big interview
events.text: A good job wants YOU for an interview tomorrow.

else.tpl: You ramble about your cat for 6 minutes. No offer.

events.title: You have been summoned
events.text: A summons orders {{s.firstName}} to jury duty: a two-week fraud trial. The boss sighs audibly.

effects.tpl: You weigh a stranger's fate carefully. Civic soul plus.

then.tpl: A crucial dentist appointment frees you.

else.tpl: Contempt warning plus $250 fine. Oops.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your graduate"}} holds a thick envelope with a university crest. Hands shaking.

effects.tpl: {{k&&k.grades>=70?"ACCEPTED! Screaming, cake, phone calls till midnight.":"Waitlisted — but the hug is full-size. Plans forming."}}
Tuition math at the kitchen table. Dreams, itemized.

text.template: Ms. Alvarez folds her hands. 'Let's talk about {{k?k.name:"your child"}} — grades {{k?k.grades:60}}, conduct '+(k&&k.trouble>3?'...lively':'a delight')+'.'

effects.tpl: 'Keep doing whatever you're doing at home,' she says.
Flashcards at breakfast. The curve bends upward.
No console till the grades move. They move.

text.template: The corner shop calls: {{k?k.name:"your kid"}} was caught pocketing sweets. The owner wants 'to make it a lesson.'

effects.tpl: Humiliation shared is humiliation halved. Lesson landed.
Forty minutes of shopkeeper thunder. Never again, apparently.

text.template: {{k?k.name+" ("+(k.trait||"young")+", wants "+(k.dream||"everything")+")":"Your grown kid"}} asks the big one over dinner: 'What should I do with my life?'

effects.tpl: 'Then go be it brilliantly.' They exhale like they've held that breath for years.
Contacts called, internship secured. Gratitude, delayed.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your kid"}} comes home with a split lip and a story that starts mid-sentence.

effects.tpl: 'Strong people forgive first.' It lands, eventually.
Pillow lessons all weekend. Nobody touches your kid again.

text.template: {{k?k.name+", backpack bigger than torso, ":"Someone small "}}faces the school gates. A {{k&&k.trait?k.trait:"brave"}} who dreams of being an {{k&&k.dream?k.dream:"explorer"}}.

effects.tpl: Hand squeezed all the way to the classroom door. Then — gone, grinning.
They walked in alone and were fine. You weren't.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your teen"}} comes home dry-eyed in the way that means crying happened elsewhere.

effects.tpl: Two hours, one tub of ice cream. They'll survive — and remember you were there.
'Plenty of fish' lands exactly as badly as expected.

text.template: Floorboard creak. {{k?k.name:"Your teen"}} freezes halfway out the window, caught red-handed.

effects.tpl: An hour of honest talk. The window stays shut after that.
Alarms, curfews, checks. Peace through paperwork.

text.template: {{k?k.name+" lets go of the couch. ":"A small miracle unfolds. "}}Wobbly. Arms out. The whole room holds its breath.

effects.tpl: Three steps! Four! The video gets watched a hundred times.
Shaky footage, perfect audio: everyone screaming with joy.

text.template: {{k?k.name+" ("+(k&&k.dream?"future "+k.dream:"big dreams")+")":"Your kid"}} made the talent-show finals and is vibrating with nerves.

effects.tpl: They scan the crowd, find you, and shine twice as bright.
Practice between chapters. Both improve, unevenly.

events.title: School calls
events.text: The school calls: your kid is in trouble. Again.

effects.tpl: A long walk, hard truths, a hug. They turn a corner.
Silence. Then slow thaw.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your child"}} announces the wedding. Date set. Your duties: show up, don't cry (cry), pay for something.

then.tpl: Flowers, tears, dancing. +10 prestige for House {{s.lastName}}.

else.tpl: The wallet says no. The day is smaller, the love isn't.

effects.tpl: Backyard vows, borrowed chairs, perfect.

events.title: Rent spike!
events.text: Landlord raises rent 30%. 'Market rates,' he shrugs.

effects.tpl: You pay. Resentment included free.
Smaller place, longer commute, $1,200 moving costs.

You walk it, raising 900 dollars. Every mile matters.

effects.tpl: A small print, won fairly. It hangs like a trophy.
Last dance, marble halls. Culture with a beat.

events.text: A mountaintop wedding: forty guests, one helicopter.

effects.tpl: Vows in thin air. The photos defy belief. Married at altitude.
Valley venue, mountain views. All grandparents attend.

events.title: Sleeper car
events.text: The night train crosses three borders while you sleep.

effects.tpl: Rocked to sleep, wake in new country. Magic with wheels.
Upright but dreaming. The sunrise border crossing: free.

events.title: Barn classic
events.text: A 1968 coupe sleeps in a barn. The price dares you.

effects.tpl: Chrome thunder returns. Trophies follow the rumble.
Patina and purrs. You drive history daily.

events.title: Paid pit
events.text: The theater pays per show. Your instrument qualifies.

effects.tpl: Forty shows, 2,400 dollars, endless overtures.
Sub calls monthly. Flexibility plus 800 dollars.

events.title: The eulogy
events.text: A parent dies. The service needs your words.

effects.tpl: You speak through tears. Two hundred people thank you after.
Your sibling reads your words. Grief shared is grief halved.

events.title: Shake plan
events.text: The fault line reminds everyone. Your kit is from 2019.

effects.tpl: Water, food, radio. Ready for the week that never comes.
Meeting point set, gas wrench placed. Calm: installed.

events.title: Track day
events.text: Your car, a real circuit, an instructor with strong opinions.

effects.tpl: Apexes hit, limits found safely. Grin lasts weeks.
Pro-driven laps recalibrate your courage. Then you drive.

events.title: Canopy walk
events.text: Hanging bridges through the canopy. Monkeys included.

effects.tpl: Toucans at eye level. The forest breathes around you.
Frogs, eyeshine, bioluminescence. The dark comes alive.

events.title: Delta dawn
events.text: Mokoros through reeds, elephants at noon, lions at dusk.

effects.tpl: Leopards at ten feet. The guide grins; you forget breathing.
Eye-level elephants. The shots win the club contest.

events.title: One city month
events.text: A month in Rome: one apartment, one language app, endless espresso.

effects.tpl: You learn the butcher's name. The city adopts you.
Two weeks, all highlights. Enough to plan the return.

events.title: Rooftop question
events.text: City lights, a ring box burning a hole, the perfect sunset.

effects.tpl: Yes among the skyline. The city applauds with horns.
You wait for the coast trip. Anticipation sweetens everything.

events.title: Risotto night
events.text: Friends, saffron, stirring in shifts. Wine mandatory.

effects.tpl: Creamy perfection at minute 22. Applause with full mouths.
Everyone stirs, everyone learns. Risotto spreads.

events.title: Trade winds
events.text: A crewed sailboat week splits among six friends.

effects.tpl: Reefs, rum, phosphorescence. The sea resets you.
You steer watches by day three. Sailor: minted.

events.title: Congress weekend
events.text: Three days of social dancing till 3am. Shoes: broken in.

then.tpl: The last dance never ends. It becomes breakfast, then more.

else.tpl: Forty dances, ten friends, zero regrets. Feet: destroyed.

effects.tpl: Styling intensives daily. Your dance levels up visibly.

events.title: Accent tutoring
events.text: Language exchange: your English for their everything-else.

then.tpl: Verbs conjugate; so do you two. Love in two languages.

else.tpl: Fluent-ish and friends. The language stays; the spark stays friendly.

effects.tpl: Steady progress, zero drama. The certificate arrives.

events.title: Red jacket
events.text: Ski patrol tryouts: skiing, medicine, courage.

then.tpl: You make the team! 3,000 dollars a season of purpose.

else.tpl: Skiing passes, medicine needs work. Next year: yours.

effects.tpl: Wilderness certification first. The mountain waits.

events.title: Sunday sauce
events.text: The sauce simmers six hours. The family gathers.

effects.tpl: Six hours, three generations, one pot. This is wealth.
Stirring lessons passed down. The recipe survives.

events.title: Slow burn
events.text: A coworker's glances linger. Adult chemistry, carefully banked.

then.tpl: Dinner runs four hours. Dessert back at yours. Mornings: tangled and grinning.

else.tpl: Lovely dinner, friendly parting. The slow burn stays warm.

effects.tpl: Boundaries held kindly. The work stays clean.

events.title: Year of wandering
events.text: Savings, health, nerve: all aligned once. A year off beckons.

effects.tpl: Twelve months, nine countries, one rewritten soul.
Three months out. Enough to change, sane to afford.

events.title: Bell ringing
events.text: The startup lists. Your options vest. The number loads slowly.

effects.tpl: Half sold: 60,000 dollars locked. The rest rides free.

then.tpl: Moon! 150,000 dollars. The patience pays wildly.

else.tpl: It dips. You still clear 20,000 dollars and a story.

events.title: Hail core
